content.text:
Resubmitted with the minimality defect cured.

**What changed from the prior version:** the rewritten residual sentence in Section 14.2.6 ("PB shall remain obligated to pay any Approval Payments ... in accordance with ARTICLE 6.") is gone; paragraph p0766 is now struck in full rather than replaced. That removes both the unnecessary duplication of Article 6 machinery and the silent loss of the PB-favourable Section 6.7 buy-out credit and Section 6.2 adjustment qualifiers, which now simply continue to operate under Article 6.

**Final redline (preferred level, all six elements met):**
1. §15.6 (p0814) — no-consent affiliate/successor carve-out narrowed to PB; SFJ assignments require our prior written consent, not unreasonably withheld.
2. §15.6 (p0817) — competitor-assignment bar made permanent (no Program Transfer sunset).
3. §14.2.6 (p0765) — retitled and SFJ's sole-discretion change-of-control termination right replaced with an express "SFJ shall have no right to terminate."
4. §14.2.6 (p0766) — deleted; its content was wholly conditioned on a termination that can no longer occur.

**Cross-reference sweep:** no provision outside p0765–p0766 refers to Section 14.2.6; Section 11.1.1.4, the Change of Control Buy-Out Payment definition (1.1.26) and Section 6.7.2, and PB's Article 6 payment obligations are untouched, as is SFJ's separate right to assign Approval Payment receipts to its limited partners.
